entity: White Birch Apartments, Milwaukee: HUD project-based Section 8 rent at $2,574 a unit a month, 223% of fair market rent
what_we_add: $2,574 a unit a month for White Birch; 223% of fair rent for its bedroom mix; highest ratio of any 100+ unit building in a cheap market outside Puerto Rico
why:
The only source, a 1998 HUD OIG audit, covers the same scheme (1,219 projects with rents over 150% of fair market rent) but never names White Birch.
No usable source names the building, so it stops at Known pattern.
